'''Haurgab''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that allied itself with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent [[Omega Squad]] to the planet, who battled the local forces in the [[Battle of Haurgab]].
